title: Optimised QIAamp® DNA Mini Kit Protocol for Bacterial Genomic DNA Extraction
author: Zhong Yang
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.21203/rs.2.17049/v1
materials: Make lysozyme buffer according to the gram-positive protocol in Qiagen Handbook.

steps.title: Prepare Bacterial Sample (Pure Culture)
steps.instruction: Prepare a bacterial pellet from a pure culture, specifically for gram-positive or difficult-to-lyse bacteria.

substeps.instruction: Pick a single pure colony for broth culture.
Collect 1ml of log phase culture in a microtube.
Centrifuge for 3min at 12000rpm to pellet bacteria.
Resuspend pellet in clear water and centrifuge again at 12000rpm for 2min.
Remove supernatant and store the pellet in liquid nitrogen or a -80℃ fridge for at least 2h.

steps.title: Freeze-Thaw Lysis Pre-treatment (Pure Culture)
steps.instruction: Perform a heat-shock and freeze cycle to break the cell wall.

substeps.instruction: Heat the pellet to 95℃ for 5min.
Vortex at top speed and short spin to remove droplets from the cap.
Return the pellet to liquid nitrogen or -80℃ fridge until lysis.

steps.title: Prepare Bacterial Sample (Liquid Sample)
steps.instruction: Collect and prepare bacteria from liquid-based samples (e.g., environmental water, drinks, or dissolved powders).

substeps.instruction: Collect bacteria using 0.45um filtration.
Wash bacteria remaining on the flask wall by adding an equal volume of 0.85% saline to the filtration flask.
Use a culture loop to swap all bacteria from the filter membrane into 1ml clear water.
Freeze the bacteria solution in liquid nitrogen or -80℃ fridge.
Boil the bacteria solution at 95℃ for 5min and return to the fridge before lysis.

steps.title: Enzymatic Lysis
steps.instruction: Perform initial enzymatic lysis of the pellet.

substeps.instruction: Remove pellet from -80℃ and melt at room temperature.
Resuspend the pellet in 180ul of lysozyme buffer.
Lysis at 37℃ and 1200rpm for 3h.

steps.title: Chemical Lysis
steps.instruction: Further lyse the mixture using AL buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 200ul AL buffer to the solution.
Lysis at 56℃ and 1000rpm for 2h until the solution becomes transparent.
Short spin the tube.
Add 8µl RNase A, mix well, and incubate at room temperature for 10min.

steps.title: DNA Binding to Column
steps.instruction: Bind the genomic DNA to the QIAamp mini spin column.

substeps.instruction: Add 200µl of pre-cold 100% ethanol (kept at -30℃) to the solution, mix well, and short spin.
Apply the mixture to the Qiagen mini spin column and centrifuge at 10000rpm for 90s.
Apply the liquid from the collection tube back to the column and centrifuge at 10000rpm for 90s.
Repeat the application/centrifugation process once more (total of 2-3 passes over the column) and discard the liquid in the collection tube.

steps.title: Column Washing
steps.instruction: Wash the bound DNA to remove contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Add 650µl of 100% pre-cold ethanol to the column and centrifuge at 12000rpm for 3min; discard the liquid.
Add 650µl of AW1 buffer to the column, centrifuge at 12000rpm for 2min, and discard the liquid.
Repeat the AW1 wash step once.
Add 650µl of AW2 buffer to the column, centrifuge at 12000rpm for 2min, and discard the liquid.
Repeat the AW2 wash step once.

steps.title: Column Drying
steps.instruction: Remove residual ethanol from the column.

substeps.instruction: Change to a new collection tube and centrifuge at 14000rpm for 3min.
Air dry the column in a BSC for 10min.
Place the column into a clean 2ml DNA low-binding tube.

steps.title: DNA Elution
steps.instruction: Elute the purified DNA from the column.

substeps.instruction: Heat pure (DNase free) water to 70℃.
Elute the DNA with 80µl of the heated water and centrifuge at 10000rpm for 2min.
Apply the resulting DNA solution back onto the column, incubate at 65℃ for 1min, and centrifuge at 12000rpm for 2min to collect the final DNA solution.
